title: Website
description: Design company pages, headers, footers, and themes, then publish a live site.
needCompany: Select a company account in WebOnOne to design a website. Pages are scoped to your active company.
pagesDescription: The site map. Create pages, open the designer, or browse the live page.
headersDescription: Headers use the same designer as pages. The published site uses the default header.
footersDescription: Footers use the same designer as pages. The published site uses the default footer.
themesDescription: Theme tokens for fonts, colors, text styles, and buttons.
mediaDescription: Company media library. Image add-ons pick files from here.
emptyPages: No pages yet. Create one to start designing.
createPageDescription: Give the page a name and URL path, then open the designer.
createHeaderDescription: Create a header layout used at the top of the published site.
createFooterDescription: Create a footer layout used at the bottom of the published site.
createThemeDescription: Create a theme, then edit fonts, colors, and styles.
name: Name
pathHint: Leave empty for the home page. Use lowercase letters, numbers, and slashes.
containerHeightHint: Matches the canvas in the editor. You can also drag the resize strip under the canvas.
containerSettingsDescription: Set height and background for the whole page, header, or footer design area.
blockSettingsDescription: Configure appearance and options for this content element.
advancedSettingPlaceholder: Advanced options will be available here.
noBlocks: Add a content element to start laying out this {{kind}}.
unsavedDescription: Leave the designer without saving? Your changes will be lost.
imageDescription: Photo or graphic from the company media library, with an optional image per breakpoint.
textDescription: Paragraph or heading that uses a theme text style.
buttonDescription: Themed button that can link to another page on this site.
addAddonDescription: Choose an add-on to place inside the selected content element.
cropDescription: Drag to reposition. Use zoom and aspect ratio controls to adjust the crop area.
label: Label
notFoundDescription: This page is missing or inactive.
